BHA Edge Out Fulham in Thrilling Battle

BHA secured a 2-1 victory over Fulham by controlling the tempo and capitalizing on crucial defensive turnovers. BHA dominated possession at 48.1% against Fulham’s 51.9%, but Fulham attempted a high press, registering a match PPDA of 8.4, which was higher than BHA’s 6.6. This indicates BHA managed the intensity better.

The match was defined by high-energy reclaiming of the ball. BHA achieved 40 high gains, while Fulham managed only 12. The decisive moment came in the 63rd minute when BHA secured a goal by #5 Isaac Kane-Moss from a set piece, assisted by #7 Tomas Calloway. This goal, with an xG of 0.37, broke FUL’s resistance and provided the necessary cushion to win the match, proving that winning the battles in the final third was key.
